tooltip: Exposure Compensation – Allows you to adjust the camera exposure level
content1: Allows you to adjust the camera exposure level to make the image brighter or darker without changing the exposure mode.
content2:
1. The PropertyRange structure holds information about a controls value range, including its ID, minimum, maximum, current, step, and default values, as well as the control mode (auto or manual). 
2. The CameraProperty Enum indicates the specific control for which value has to be extracted.
getAPIDes: This function retrieves the current minimum and maximum exposure compensation value of the camera.
setAPIHeading: bool writeExposureCompensationMin(int value) and bool writeExposureCompensationMax(int value)
setAPIDes: This function sets the exposure compensation value of the camera.

tooltip: Flip Control - Controls horizontal and vertical image flipping
content1: Controls horizontal and vertical flipping of the camera image output. Horizontal and vertical flip can be enabled or disabled independently.
content2: HFLIP Control (0x0C): 0x00 = OFF, 0x01 = ON. VFLIP Control (0x0D): 0x00 = OFF, 0x01 = ON. The response status byte uses 0x00 for Failed and 0x01 for Success.
getAPIHeading: bool readHorizontalFlip(bool* value) / bool readVerticalFlip(bool* value)
getAPIDes: These functions read the current horizontal or vertical flip state. The output bool is true when the returned value is 0x01.
setAPIHeading: bool writeHorizontalFlip(bool value) / bool writeVerticalFlip(bool value)
setAPIDes: These functions enable or disable horizontal or vertical flip. Pass true to write 0x01 and false to write 0x00.
